﻿ Underlying Nifty Bank Index Option style European The Nifty Bank index, commonly known as Bank Nifty, is a key benchmark tracking the Indian banking sector. Managed by the National Stock Exchange (NSE), it comprises the 12 most liquid and large-cap public and private banks in India, including giants like HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and the State Bank of India. The index uses a free-float market-cap weighting method and serves as a reliable barometer for the health of India's banking system and broader economy. Show more
